Callout.Name: Fuel Drive-Off
Callout.Message: Vehicle left a filling station without paying.
Callout.Advisory: Plates noted, driver headed for the freeway.

Script.Line: The pump would not take my card. I was going to come back.
I live ten minutes from here. Ask anybody.
I will pay it now. I will pay it now, in cash.

Lines.Approach: Filled it and left. Plates are with the station and they would like a word.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
